title: A loom pattern
description:
Weave a pattern from punched cards, like the Jacquard loom.

```
card 1: 10011001  ->  #..##..#
card 2: 01100110  ->  .##..##.
...
```
hints: `card.replace("1", "#").replace("0", ".")` turns one card into one row of cloth (lesson 1.02).
`card.count("1")` counts the lifted threads on a card.
requirements: Each card is a string of 0s and 1s; a 1 lifts a thread (`#`), a 0 leaves it down (`.`).
Print the woven cloth, then the same cards repeated twice to make a longer piece.
Count how many threads were lifted in total.
stretch: Let the user type their own cards, and mirror each row so the pattern is symmetrical.
